description:
As an MLOps engineer, you want to track your experiment artifacts by verifying their integrity using checksums. In your workspace directory at /home/user/mlruns/artifacts/, you have a file named trained_model.pt. Your task is to calculate its SHA256 checksum and then create a log file named artifact_checksum.log in the same directory. The log file must contain a single line in the following format: 
trained_model.pt SHA256: <checksum_value>
where <checksum_value> is the actual SHA256 checksum string (64 lowercase hexadecimal digits) of trained_model.pt. Make sure there are no extra spaces or lines in the log file. The automated test will check for this precise file, filename, and line format.
